products.title: Wells M404 MRT Gel Blaster - Nylon
products.body_html:
Description

Wells M404 MRT Gel Blaster - Nylon

A classic M4 shape gel blaster with some style to it.

The Mid Range Tactical (MRT) continues the Well M4 evolution along a full nylon build including nylon gears, long alloy barrel flip-up, and down metal "iron sights” crowned with a sleek MLOK-inspired fore-end rail finishing off with a flash hider.

The Well MRT has been made in all nylon to give a sturdier feel and with a strong nylon gearbox and nylon gears. The fore end alloy guard is MLOK so to attach grips you will need to use MLOK attachments or Picatinny rails with MLOK points so you can use more common Picatinny style attachments.

Features

  • Nylon Receiver
  • Nylon Iron Sights
  • MLOK Handguard
  • Metal Buffer Tube Sling Mount
  • Colour: Black
  • FPS: 230 FPS -/+

**Orange tip shown for illustration purposes**

Specs

  • Gel Type: 7-8mm
  • Inner barrel size (ID): 7.25mm
  • Inner barrel length:  31.5cm
  • Barrel Type: Alloy
  • T-Piece: N-Wells
  • Battery Source: 7.4v 1200mah JST plug
  • Gearbox Type: AEG V2
  • Gear Type: Nylon 18:1
  • Bearings/Bushings: 6mm Bushings
  • Spring: 1.2
  • Motor: 480 Long
  • Mosfet: No
  • Piston Type: Nylon with Metal Rack 14-tooth
  • Cylinder Head & Nozzle Type: Alloy Cylinder Head & Nozzle
  • Cylinder Porting: Non-Ported
  • Velocity:  220 FPS -/+
  • Fire Selector: Safe / Semi Auto / Full Auto
  • Nylon Iron Sights
  • Nylon Outer Barrel
  • Nylon Receiver & Handguard
  • Magazine: Well M4 Magazine
  • Suitable Gels: Milkies
  • Length: 73.5cm

In the Box

  • 1 x Wells M403 - Nylon Gel Blaster
  • 1 x Wells M4 Magazine
  • 1 x Pack of Gel Balls (Recommend TEH Hardened Whites Instead Though)
  • 1 x Safety Glasses

** Battery and Charger not included

IMPORTANT INFORMATION

Charging Batteries

Do not leave batteries unattended whilst charging and take off charge when they have completed setting.

When charging the batteries, we recommend charging them between 1-4 hours.
When they are charging the light/s will flash and once it is fully charged, the light/s will turn a solid red or green.

Also, once you see the battery getting flat, please recharge it as running it flat can damage the cells.

 Soaking & Storage of Gels

When soaking the gels, they must be absorbed fully submerged in water from the tap for a minimum of 5-6 hours.

Once fully grown you can leave them in the water and keep them in or out of the refrigerator.

When you are ready to use them just drain any excess water with a strainer before you feed them into the mag but do not dry them as they need to be lubricated to work correctly.

You can store gel balls in a bucket of water with a lid for up to 3 months before they start to go super soft. We recommend that you do this to change the water every couple of weeks.

DISCLAIMER
 Do not upgrade any part of your toy gel blaster as this will void the warranty. Upgrades refer to pulling any of the blasters apart or opening it up, changing springs, or upgrading the battery from 7.4v to an 11.v battery.

Description

Gel Blaster Hard Shell Quick Pull Hi Capa Holster

This holster is designed for quickly drawing your Hi-Capa pistol during Gelsoft skirmishes. The paddle attachment system allows for fast mounting to your belt without having to remove it. The black colour matches virtually any loadout.

Material and Functionality

This holster is made from durable nylon and features a rigid construction that securely holds your replica in place. The quick pull mechanism with its distinctive release button enables you to draw your pistol in one smooth motion. The paddle platform ensures stability during movement.

Use During Skirmishes

This Gelsoft holster is worn on the hip via the paddle system that slides behind your waistband. The rotating attachment gives you the freedom to adjust the angle for optimal carrying comfort. During CQB situations, you can rely on quick access to your secondary weapon. The design prevents your pistol from accidentally falling out of the holster while running or crawling.

Who Is This Holster Suitable For?

This holster is suitable for both beginners and advanced players who want reliable and fast access to their Hi-Capa pistol. Thanks to the paddle system, this holster is ideal for players who frequently switch between different trousers or belts. It fits well with a dynamic playing style where speed is important.

 Soaking & Storage of Gels

When soaking the gels, they need to be soaked fully submerged in water from the tap for a minimum of 5-6 hours.

Once they have fully grown you can leave them in the water and keep them in or out of the refrigerator.

When you are ready to use them just drain of any excess water with a strainer before you feed them into the mag but do not dry them as they need to be lubricated to work properly.

You can store gel balls in a bucket of water with a lid for up to 3 months before they start to go super soft. We recommend if you do this to change the water every couple of weeks.

products.title: Green Gas Powered Twister Grenade by 40 Max
products.body_html:
Description

Green Gas Powered Twister Grenade by 40 Max

A simple and highly effective twister grenade, that goes off on impact, holds approximately 100 gelballs and is powered by Green Gas.

Low refill cost using any commercial lubricated green gas(we prefer using the Abbey Predator 144A Gas or Warwolf Green Gas W2 10kg for best results and longer lasting product). Best filled with gels under 7.5mm,  or the pack you never used that came with your gel blaster.

Made out of CNC machined and anodised aluminium and a plastic shell, these are a hardy little device that will generally handle anything you can throw them out whilst out in the bush, or on the CQB field.

Always wear AS/NZS rated eye protection when using these devices.

Loading Method

  • Confirm the grenade is empty.

  • Confirm the firing mechanism has been reset, by pushing the button on the top down, and inserting the pin.

  • Load the gel balls using either a bottle or pistol style speed loader.
  • Throw at or onto a firm surface. These work best when they land on their side.

– Note that these grenades will benefit from a fill with Maintenance Green Gas every 10-20 shots.

products.title: Aztech 8mm Low Profile Bushes 440 Stainless V2 Gearbox
products.body_html:
Description

Aztech 8mm Low Profile Bushes 440 Stainless V2 Gearbox

Custom made CNC bushes by Aztech Innovations

Manufactured from 440 grade stainless steel with rockwell hardness of 60HRC

Machined to 8mm (8.02mm ) to within 0.001mm tolerances. These are made .02 of a mm oversize to ensure a snug fit without warping the gearbox from over tension. 

We recommend a light press or bearing tool for installation. Do not Impact with a hammer or blunt force tooling to ensure no damage is caused to the gearbox.  We highly recommend using a JB Weld Original epoxy as an adhesive to bond the bushes into place to ensure they can not move or come loose in the gearbox.

Suits V2 and V3 style gearbox's - gel ball and airsoft compatible.  May be too shallow for some nylon gearboxes to be securely retained.
These do not suit Singularity 13 Gen 8 Gearboxes.

Includes 6x Bushes

Stainless bushes must be lubricated with a high quality bearing and gear grease.  We highly recommend Nulon Xtreme Performance Grease with PTFE (L80) which is a blend of Polytetrafluoroethylene (PTFE) fluorocarbon particles in a specially prepared lithium-based, water-repellent grease. 

PTFE L80 keeps water and dust out while a plating of PTFE is applied to the mating surfaces under working conditions. Seal performance is improved and operating temperature reduced, resulting in less grease "throw". L80 is the perfect grease for our CNC bushes and gears.

L80 has a continuous temperature operating range of -9°C to 150°C

Description

A&K Full Size M1 Garand Gel Blaster AEG with Real Wood Furniture - Darker Wood

The first standard issue semi-automatic rifle issued to the US Armed Forces, the M1 Garand was referred to as "the greatest battle implement ever devised" by General George S. Patton. Replacing the venerable Springfield M1903 in 1936, the M1 Garand quickly displayed its huge advantage on the battlefield. During World War II, the M1 Garand saw extensive use and gave US forces a major advantage in firefights against Axis soldiers who were usually issued slower bolt-action rifles. The M1 Garand remained in service throughout the Korean War and even had limited deployment in the early years of the Vietnam War. The rifle still continues to be used even in the modern day by drill teams and military honour guards as well as in the civilian market long after it was retired from active service.

A&K has faithfully reproduced the venerable M1 Garand in an AEG that everyone can afford. Striving to offer the most realism and reliability for your dollar, the A&K M1 Garand features a stained wood stock and a metal alloy receiver and barrel assembly giving this M1 a realistic look and feel that will have you believing you are pushing through the hedgerows in the south of France. Internally the A&K M1 Garand is powered by a version 7 gearbox allowing a level of customization and upgradeability not found in other M1 AEG replicas on the market. While all the major features of a good M1 Garand replica are there, A&K did not skimp on the details including a period correct safety, bayonet lug, sling rings stacking swivel and an authentic sight picture. Whether you are a WWII re-enactor or an gel blaster player looking to field a unique rifle, the A&K M1 Garand delivers on looks, performance, realism and usability that puts it at the front of the pack.

products.body_html:

The KELe Colt Peacemaker Manual Revolver pistols are next level in quality and these are no exception.  A solid nylon built will definitely please any collector.  These shoot gels and small foam darts, so you can really get into the spirit of slinging and target shooting. The The KELe Colt Peacemaker Manual Revolver pistols are a single action trigger, meaning the hammer has to be cocked back, for each shot.

The Colt Single Action Army (also known as the SAA, Model P, Peacemaker, or M1873) is a single-action revolver . It was designed for the U.S. government service revolver trials of 1872 by Colt’s Patent Firearms Manufacturing Company (today known as Colt’s Manufacturing Company) and was adopted as the standard-issued pistol of the U.S. Army from 1873 until 1892

Soaking & Storage of Gels

When soaking the gels, they need to be soaked fully submerged in warm water from the tap for a minimum of 4-6 hours.

Once they have fully grown you can leave them in the water and keep them in or out of the refrigerator.

When you are ready to use them just drain off any excess water with a strainer before you feed them into the mag but do not dry them as they need to be lubricated to work properly.

products.title: Aztech Innovations Perfect Pinion
products.body_html:
Description

Aztech Innovations Perfect Pinion

Aztech Innovations have done it again! Designing this pinion from the ground up to improve it in every way. The tooth design is designed to make it as efficient, super strong and quiet as possible. The increase diameter of the shaft enables it to use a much larger M3 size grub screw meaning you will be able to make sure it is tightened harder on the motor shaft and not strip those tiny allen keys all the time. It also means there is more contact area for loctite to hold. The grub screw will be the torx type meaning extra ability for tightening and come with the torx key to suit.

The bevelled area on the larger shaft also means that for assembly, you adjust the motor up all the way till the bevel hits the bevel gear (while not running) then back it off one turn for the perfect alignment.

Made of SCM440, then quenched, tempered and then nitride treatment means this pinion is the strongest pinion on the market bar none!

products.title: Acetech Bifrost Tracer Unit with Multi Color Flame Effect ( RGB Rainbow ) ( M14 CCW )
products.body_html:
Description

Acetech Bifrost Tracer Unit with Multi-Color Flame Effect ( RGB Rainbow ) ( M14 CCW )

The new ACETECH BiFROST tracer unit supports green and water gels. The unit comes in 11 modes in total and loops in the following sequence:

1. Red/Orange/Yellow/Green/Blue/Pink/Purple Beam and Flame.  The Flame LED flashes the color of the mode switched to.

2. RGB Beam/Flame – The flame LED flashes R/G/B for once

3. Rainbow Beam/Flame – This flame LED flashes white twice

4. Rainbow Dynamic – The Flame LED flashes white three times.

5. Demo – The flame LED flashes white for four times

6. Turn OFF – Turn Off flame functions.  The Power indicator flashes green three times or keeps blinking.

  • Unit simulates muzzle flash, the effect of the flame depends on the volume of gas or water fog around the muzzle, with more volume, the effect will be better

products.title: Golden Eagle Tactical Pump Action Gas Powered Shotgun Gel Blaster - Gel8874
products.body_html:
Description

Golden Eagle Gel8881 Gas Powered Shotgun Gel Blaster

If you're into competitive shooting  or simply like to see beverage cans explode in the garden, this is the M870 for you! The Golden Eagle Type 870 M8874 Tactical Shotgun  makes a devasting target shooting platform with the added satisfaction of its awesome pump action mechanism and 3 or 6 shot fire modes.

This version is rocking an extended receiver rail with a built-in 5-shell "side saddle", allowing you to carry 5 extra shells on the side of the platform, well placed for fast access in the heat of the moment. Amongst the extended rails other perks are an extra QD sling socket on either side at the front and plenty of space to mount accessories, including the pre-installed Troy-style flip up iron sights.

Starting at the front of the Golden Eagle Type 870 M8874 Railed Gas Shotgun we are met with a wide outer barrel. This is typical shotgun fashion,  where the wide barrel is required for fitting the shotgun slugs in. This isn't necessary for a gelsoft shotgun due to the small nature of a gel, but staying true to the Remington model 870 silhouette gains bonus points from realism fans and of course, it looks awesome!

Running along the top of the outer barrel we are treated to an extended 20mm Picatinny rail, ready for any 20mm accessories you choose to mount. This extended rail also includes a built-in QD sling socket on either side of the front and a shell holder on the left side of the receiver, providing room for up to 5 shells stored close to the action for rapid reloads. This extended rail is a slight departure from the classic M870 aesthetic but really makes this shotgun stand out and fit in nicely with other modern platforms.

Attached to the magazine tube we find the pump action handle. This black polymer piece has ridges on to ensure a sturdy grip when racking the Type 870 M8874. When racked back, it makes a satisfying clicking noise, which is also heard when pushing it back into place and arming the shotgun.

This shotgun features a safety control which is found at the rear of the trigger guard. It is a push-through style button. When it protrudes out the right side of the trigger guard the gun is on safe and the trigger locks, when it sticks out the left side, it is not on safe and can be fired if it is armed.

At the rear, we are equipped with the prolific M4/AR-15 buffer tube, compatible with almost every aftermarket M4/AR-15 stock on the market.

When soaking the gels, they need to be absorbed fully submerged in water from the tap for a minimum of 5-6 hours.

products.title: APS SDU2.0 Mosfet Unit
products.body_html:
Description

These Mosfets are direct replacement for the original mosfet in the current APS SDU2.0 gearboxes.


These will not suit older silveredge gearboxes or any other V2 gearbox, these are propietary for APS eSilveredge SDU 2.0 ONLYe-Silver Edge Gear Box SDU2.0 (Ambidextrous design)

APS SDU2.0 Electronic Gear Box, A Super Dynamic Micro Chip Unit that works together with magnet gears set, reinforced piston, quick change spring guide and micro switch trigger that gives you instant trigger response when shooting.  The circuit board of the micro-chip is replaceable and programmable. Repairing is easy and friendly. Simply pressing down the button underneath of the gear box, user can switch its fire selector modes (total 5 different modes). No external device or trigger control are needs, it is easy to program anytime and anywhere by the user.

These mosfets are capable of decent performance but they are not designed for high spring pressures and high rate of fire. The load capacity is similar to all basic mosfets.  Motors that draw high amp levels and run hot are not recommended for this mosfet.

These factory replacement APS mosfets will require magazine power cables and terminals added as these are not gel blaster specific mosfets.

Max recommended spring is M110
Max rate of fire 25 rps

Pre-Programmed Firing Modes

Mode 1 - Safe / Semi / AutoMode 2 - Safe / Semi / 3rd BurstMode 3 - Safe / 2rd Burst / AutoMode 4 - Safe / 3rd Burst / AutoMode 5 - Safe / 3rd Burst / 9rd Burst

How to change the mode?

Step 1) Press and hold the button that is up betwen the magazine terminals, we recomend using a plastic pick or wooden tooth pick The button on these repacement units will sit 4mm higher up into the magazine terminal plate than the factory fitted unit.. You will see a Red LED light on, hold till you see its blinking 2 times, release the button to accept the changes. Repeat Step 1 to continue your choice.

products.title: WE Tech G-Series Gen 4 G34 GBB Pistol Gel Blaster (Black)
products.body_html:
Description 

WE TECH G-Series Gen 4 G34 GBB Pistol Gel Blaster (Black) is Here!

The G-Series 34 gel blaster is a competition version of G-Series 17 which fires the same round as G-Series 17 and was introduced in 1998 in order to meet the maximum size requirement for many sanctioned action gelsoft pistol sporting events.

It features a longer barrel and slide (0.8 inch more) of G-Series 17 and the top of the slide and parts of its inside are milled out, creating a conspicuous hole at the top designed to reduce front-end muzzle weight to better balance the pistol and reduce the overall weight of the slide.

Although the G-Series 34 is mainly for sport shooting, some law enforcement uses the G-Series 34 as their sidearm based on its high accuracy.

The WE TECH G-Series 34 gel blaster features a Metal Slide with a “G-Series v34 Tactical” marking, a discrete ejector and outer barrel, a fixed front sight with white dots on the outer barrel, and tactical rear sight with white dots.

It also features a Polymer Gen 4 Lower Frame with “Gen 4” marking, an extended slide stop, and 2 pcs of changeable grip with extended pin and Realistic trigger function, the same as real steel.

WE TECH gas blowback gel blaster pistols represent some of the best value and best bang for buck pistols proven worldwide as high performers and reliability above their price tag, these gelsoft versions are no different!

products.title: Fighting Bro Shims Kit
products.body_html:
Description

Fighting Bro Shims Kit

x1 Set of Shims 
x5 - 0.1mm 
x5 - 0.2mm
x5 - 0.3mm
x5 - 0.5mm

Shimming is the practice of using small spacers (shims) to precisely align the gears in your gearbox so that they operate smoothly. A poorly shimmed gearbox often results in a loud whining noise while firing, premature parts wear, stress on the motor, a reduced rate of fire, and poor battery life.

The goal is to space the gears in such a way that maximises contact between the teeth on each gear while minimising the amount of space that the gears have to move side-to-side within the gearbox. It is also extremely important that the gears are not shimmed excessively, which would cause them to bind up with one another or the gearbox itself.

Proper shimming is essential for any gearbox, and can make a huge difference in performance. Even gearboxes with the best quality parts will feel cheap and sluggish if they are not shimmed well. 

It is an essential part of having a well run gearbox!

products.title: Lonex A5 Durable Standard Motor (480 Short)
products.body_html:
Description

Lonex Durable Standard Motor

This motor is not recommended to be used on M120 springs or higher, as this could cause damage to the motor. 

This is a 480 Short Shaft motor.

The Shaft on this motor is an O-Shape shaft, only suitable to fit with O-Shape Pinion Gears.

Lonex

Lonex is a well known manufacturer across the world. For quite some time, Lonex Products have proven to perform exceptionally well under the most extreme conditions. Lonex motors use high resistance enamelled wire, up to 200°C, to build the core of the motor. This helps the motor to maintain the temperature at an efficient level, even under full power, also it greatly increases the durability of the motor while decreasing battery consumption.

A set of ball bearings are installed at both ends of the motor, not only improves the rotations but also further improves energy consumption. The front end of the motor has an aluminum cage to improve rotations as well as a high durability nylon cover at the rear end to withstand the high temperatures and extreme wear of the motor. lastly, the motor pinion gear uses high density steel that can endure the extreme rotation and pressure under high torque or high speed set up.

Soaking & Storage of Gels

When soaking the gels, they need to be soaked fully submerged in water from the tap for a minimum of 5-6 hours.

Once they have fully grown you can leave them in the water and keep them in or out of the refrigerator.

When you are ready to use them just drain of any excess water with a strainer before you feed them into the mag but do not dry them as they need to be lubricated to work properly.

You can store gel balls in a bucket of water with a lid for up to 3 months before they start to go super soft. We recommend if you do this to change the water every couple of weeks.

products.title: Cybergun FN Herstal-Licensed SCAR-SC Compact AEG Gel Blaster REPLICA
products.body_html:
Description

Cybergun FN Herstal-Licensed SCAR-SC Compact AEG Gel Blaster REPLICA

Licensed gel blaster replica of the well-known Belgian subcompact carbine FN SCAR-SC, produced by Fabrique Nationale de Herstal. The SCAR-SC is one of the most recognizable and iconic firearm models manufactured by FN Herstal. Its distinctive design and compact size make it ideal for use by special forces and counter-terrorism units in hostage rescue operations and Close-quarters combat (CQC).

The CYMA replica of the SCAR-SC, licensed by CYBERGUN, is an exact reproduction of the original model. The collaboration between these two companies has resulted in a licensed model that offers good-quality craftsmanship at an affordable price. This allows both gel blaster enthusiasts and collectors to enjoy owning this renowned replica, whether they engage in gelsoft sports or simply appreciate unique replicas.

Similar to the original SCAR, the replica is primarily made of aluminium and polymer. The upper receiver, barrel, stock, rail systems, and other smaller components are made of aluminium and other metal alloys, while the lower receiver, pistol grip, and stock pad are made of polymer, just like the real thing. The FN SCAR CQC rifle was designed as an ambidextrous weapon to meet the requirements of special forces and provide reliability and mobility during military operations. The gel blaster SCAR-SC follows suit, featuring an ambidextrous fire selector lever, an ambi magazine release, sling attachment points, and a reversible charging handle. 

Features

  • Fully licensed replica of the FN Herstal SCAR-SC Compact PDW
  • High quality full metal upper receiver and polymer lower receiver, just like the real rifle
  • Mag priming function available when pull charging handle
  • Compared to its bigger brothers, the compact PDW size of the SCAR-SC makes it a perfect option for CQB, vehicle ops, or any other situation where you need as small as rifle as possible
  • Ambidextrous 3-position selectors and magazine releases are easy to use both right- and left-handed
  • Monolithic 12 o'clock rail and additional rails at 3, 6, and 9 o'clock positions for attaching optics, grips, lights, lasers, and other standard 20mm RIS accessories
  • Special 3-position adjustable PDW stock collapses down far further than a standard buffer tube stock and features a wide rubberized buttpad for comfort
  • Functioning mock bolt lock
  • Sling mount rings built into the upper receiver on both sides
  • Includes flip-up front and rear iron sights

Manufacturer: Cybergun / CYMA (Licensed by FN Herstal)

FPS Range: 280-300

Specifications

  • Length: 535mm - 650mm (Adjustable)
  • Weight: 3280g
  • Thread Direction: 14mm Negative (CCW)
  • Gearbox: Ver 2 Full Metal, Fully Upgradeable
  • Motor: 480 Long
  • Fire Modes: Semi/Full-Auto, Safety
  • Electric Blowback: No
  • Battery: 7.4v Small Type LiPo Recommended (Wired To Rear w/ Standard mini Tamiya Connector). Battery Not Included
  • Magazine: CYMA AR magazine only
  • Package Includes: SCAR SC, Magazine

Battery & Charger Not Included

In the Box

  • 1 x Cybergun FN Herstal-Licensed SCAR-SC Compact AEG Gel Blaster REPLICA
  • 1 x Magazine

IMPORTANT INFORMATION

Warning! Choking Hazard Small Parts

This Product Contains Silicone Bead. Not for children under 3 years.

Do not aim at eyes or face.

Always use the appropriate eye wear and take all reasonable safety precautions when using our products.

Charging Batteries

Do not leave batteries unattended whilst charging and take off charge when they have completed charging.

When charging the batteries, we recommend charging them between 1-4 hours.
When they are charging the light/s will flash and once it is fully charged, the light/s will turn a solid red or green.

Also once you start to hear the battery getting flat, please recharge it as running it flat can damage the cells.

Soaking & Storage of Gels

When soaking the gels, they need to be soaked fully submerged in water from the tap for a minimum of 5-6 hours.

Once they have fully grown you can leave them in the water and keep them in or out of the refrigerator.

When you are ready to use them just drain of any excess water with a strainer before you feed them into the mag but do not dry them as they need to be lubricated to work properly.

You can store gel balls in a bucket of water with a lid for up to 3 months before they start to go super soft. We recommend if you do this to change the water every couple of weeks.

DISCLAIMER
Do not upgrade any part of your toy gel blaster as this will void the warranty. Upgrades refer to pulling any of the blaster apart or opening it up, changing springs or upgrading the battery from 7.4v to an 11.v battery.

products.title: A&K Full Size M1 Garand Gel Blaster AEG with Real Wood Furniture
products.body_html:
Description

A&K Full Size M1 Garand Gel Blaster AEG with Real Wood Furniture

The first standard issue semi-automatic rifle issued to the US Armed Forces, the M1 Garand was referred to as "the greatest battle implement ever devised" by General George S. Patton. Replacing the venerable Springfield M1903 in 1936, the M1 Garand quickly displayed its huge advantage on the battlefield. During World War II, the M1 Garand saw extensive use and gave US forces a major advantage in firefights against Axis soldiers who were usually issued slower bolt-action rifles. The M1 Garand remained in service throughout the Korean War and even had limited deployment in the early years of the Vietnam War. The rifle still continues to be used even in the modern day by drill teams and military honour guards as well as in the civilian market long after it was retired from active service.

A&K has faithfully reproduced the venerable M1 Garand in an AEG that everyone can afford. Striving to offer the most realism and reliability for your dollar, the A&K M1 Garand features a stained wood stock and a metal alloy receiver and barrel assembly giving this M1 a realistic look and feel that will have you believing you are pushing through the hedgerows in the south of France. Internally the A&K M1 Garand is powered by a version 7 gearbox allowing a level of customization and upgradeability not found in other M1 AEG replicas on the market. While all the major features of a good M1 Garand replica are there, A&K did not skimp on the details including a period correct safety, bayonet lug, sling rings stacking swivel and an authentic sight picture. Whether you are a WWII re-enactor or an gel blaster player looking to field a unique rifle, the A&K M1 Garand delivers on looks, performance, realism and usability that puts it at the front of the pack.

Features

  • Full size replica of the trusted M1 Garand battle rifle w/ beautifully stained real wood furniture
  • Metal receiver and barrel assembly
  • Adjustable rear sight
  • Front and rear sling rings; Stacking swivel
  • Version 7 gearbox
  • Deans Connection for Battery
  • Functioning trigger guard safety
  • Drop free magazine feeds from the bottom of the rifle; Low profile magazine release on the left side of the receiver maintains traditional M1 styling

products.title: Puff Dino ‘Green Gas’ 12kg - Gel Blaster Gas
products.body_html:
Description

PUFF DINO Green Gas

PUFF DINO Green Gas is manufactured by the leading manufacturer of aerosol products in Taiwan. PUFF DINO gas is produced from an ISO 9001 certificated facility, so it is of high quality.
Puff Dino Green Gas has added suitable silicone oil to aid lubricant and power of every shot.

Special Features

  • This product is high power quality gas that is perfectly mixed with silicon to improve your gel blaster performance.
  • The added silicon will protect your blaster; lubricate the internal parts while you are shooting and provide consistency in every shooting experience you have.
  • Silicon is added as pure liquefied gas will cause an instant chilling effect right after leave the pressurized cylinder and making plastic/rubber parts weakened and brittle.
  • With high-quality silicone added, it will help to prevent parts from aging quickly. Therefore enhances longevity, provides maintenance and smoothness in shooting.
  • The metal nozzle design will increase the life of usage and prevent leakage of green gas. By using green gas, our product is eco-friendly and harmless to the environment.

How to use

  • Hold the green gas cylinder upside down and press the cylinder nozzle straight down into the magazine valve (gently so as not to damage your magazine gas inlet valve). 
  • Once you see the green gas leak out from the magazine valve; you can stop filling.
  • The effectiveness of gas pressure will differ due to ambient temperatures (cold vs hot environments).

Specs

  • Volume: 600 ml
  • 12 KG Pressure
  • Packaging: 1
  • Ingredient : C3H8, Silicone Oil

Do not leave batteries unattended whilst charging and take off charge when they have completed charging.

When charging the batteries, we recommend charging them between 1-4 hours.
When they are charging the light/s will flash and once it is fully charged, the light/s will turn a solid red or green.

Soaking & Storage of Gels

When soaking the gels, they need to be soaked fully submerged in water from the tap for a minimum of 5-6 hours.

products.title: Silicone Gun Oil - 30ml
products.body_html:
Description

Silicone Gun Oil - 30ml

Silicone Gun Oil is a high quality silicone lubricant for the seals and internals of gelsoft blasters. It also produces a fine high sheen finish on all blasters and accessories that protects from moisture and dirt, eliminating rusting and corrosion.

It is highly water repellent to prevent rain and water attaching to your blaster. Just like a well polished car rainwater beads and runs off. This prevents rusting and corrosion even while you are shooting in the worse of weathers.

Silicone Gun Oil has a couple of major advantages over mineral oils. It is not harmful to wood; mineral oil penetrates and softens wood. The joint between stock and lock can become weak over time. Silicone Gun Oil prevents this happening and can be used all over the blaster. Keep clear of chequering though as the silicone is slippery!

Silicone Gun Oil does not evaporate like mineral oils so you keep an oily film for much longer. At the end of the season give a quick application and the guns will be protected until you need them again.

Fingerprints can be a major problem, especially where fingers touch the barrels. The acids within the skin attack the barrels and cause pitting, allowing rust to form. Application of Silicone Gun Oil prevents fingerprints and stops pitting from starting.

products.body_html:
Description

WE GBB Galaxy Hi-Capa Series Premium S Slide K GBB Gel Blaster - Black

The WE-Tech Galaxy series is a whole new family of products with similar designs, which will use magazines from pistols most Gelsoft players are familiar with. The next member of the Galaxy family now comes with an industry-beloved Hi-CAPA style frame. With controls and features familiar to those who love the Hi-CAPA gel blaster series, it's a fresh take on the design.

The upper receiver portion of this gelsoft pistol features an enclosed bolt inside a futuristic-looking barrel assembly with a ventilated barrel shroud. Always use the appropriate eye wear and take all reasonable safety precautions when using our products.

Soaking & Storage of Gels

When soaking the gels, they need to be soaked fully submerged in warm water from the tap for a minimum of 4-6 hours.

Once they have fully grown you can leave them in the water and keep them in or out of the refrigerator.

When you are ready to use them just drain off any excess water with a strainer before you feed them into the mag but do not dry them as they need to be lubricated to work properly.

When soaking the gels, they need to be soaked fully submerged in warm water from the tap for a minimum of 4-6 hours.

Once they have fully grown you can leave them in the water and keep them in or out of the refrigerator.

When you are ready to use them just drain off any excess water with a strainer before you feed them into the mag but do not dry them as they need to be lubricated to work properly.

products.body_html:
Description

SHS 18:1 Carbon Steel Gears

SHS Gears 18:1 ratio

This Gear set is the same ratio as standard gearboxes.

These gears will require shimming.

Features

Pinion Gear: 10 teeth
Bevel Gear: has three layers of teeth: the inner layer of 10 teeth; the outer layer is 30 teeth; the middle is 4 teeth;
Spur Gear: has two layers of teeth: the inner layer is 20 teeth, and the outer layer is 39 teeth;
Sector Gear: has two layers of teeth: the inner layer is 32 teeth, and the outer layer is 16 teeth;

Count the gear for example:
Pinion Gear (3.0 laps) → Bevel Gear (1.0 laps)
Bevel Gear (3.9 laps) → Spur Gear (1.0 laps)
Spur Gear (1.6 laps) → Sector Gear (1.0 laps)
3.0 x 3.9 x 1.6 = 18.72

Description

Lonex A1 Motor

Up to 45k RPM with no load. 
This motor is not recommended to be used on M120 springs or higher, as this could cause damage to gearbox internals. 

This is a 480 Short Shaft motor.

The Shaft on this motor is an O-Shape shaft, only suitable to fit with O-Shape Pinion Gears.

Lonex

Lonex is a well known manufacturer across the world. For quite some time, Lonex Products have proven to perform exceptionally well under the most extreme conditions. Lonex motors use high resistance enamelled wire, up to 200°C, to build the core of the motor. This helps the motor to maintain the temperature at an efficient level, even under full power, also it greatly increases the durability of the motor while decreasing battery consumption.

A set of ball bearings are installed at both ends of the motor, not only improves the rotations but also further improves energy consumption. The front end of the motor has an aluminium cage to improve rotations as well as a high durability nylon cover at the rear end to withstand the high temperatures and extreme wear of the motor. lastly, the motor pinion gear uses high density steel that can endure the extreme rotation and pressure under high torque or high speed set up.

products.title: Lonex Motor A3 (480 Short)
products.body_html:
Description

Lonex Motor A3 High Speed Revolution Motor

Up to 40k RPM with no load. 
This motor is not recommended to be used on M110 springs or lower, as this could cause damage to gearbox internals. 

This is a 480 Short Shaft motor.

The Shaft on this motor is an O-Shape shaft, only suitable to fit with O-Shape Pinion Gears.

Lonex

Lonex is a well known manufacturer across the world. For quite some time, Lonex Products have proven to perform exceptionally well under the most extreme conditions. Lonex motors use high resistance enamelled wire, up to 200°C, to build the core of the motor. This helps the motor to maintain the temperature at an efficient level, even under full power, also it greatly increases the durability of the motor while decreasing battery consumption.

A set of ball bearings are installed at both ends of the motor, not only improves the rotations but also further improves energy consumption. The front end of the motor has an aluminium cage to improve rotations as well as a high durability nylon cover at the rear end to withstand the high temperatures and extreme wear of the motor. lastly, the motor pinion gear uses high density steel that can endure the extreme rotation and pressure under high torque or high speed set up.

This product is suited for Toy Gel Blasters

Gel blasters are toys only and are NOT weapons or firearms.
